p.bio: Growing up as an expat, having lived in multiple countries, Bahrain, Botswana, St Lucia, Turks and Caicos, England, to name a few, but always periodically returning home to the Seychelles, I was always ready to settle down and truly enjoy my home islands, and after 15 years in the UAE, I did just that and bought a racing yacht.Sailing in the tropical paradise of the Seychelles, warm water and breezes, blue skies, green islands is hard to beat. I have always been enamored with the sea, a competitive sports man and an environmentalist, sailing manages to tick all the boxes for me.

c: African & Oceanian Qualifiers - SSL Gold Cup 2026
